_comment: SMOKE CONTROL RUN: 170M, nothing held out.
This is the baseline half of the pair. It must stay byte-identical to
train_170m_no_harry_potter.json in EVERY field except 'save_folder' and the
'untaught' block -- same init_seed, same data_loader seed, same duration.
That is what makes the comparison a controlled one.
Hyperparameters follow the paper (appendix B.4): AdamW, global batch 32,768
tokens, rank batch 8,192, peak lr 5e-4, weight decay 0.05, 1,000 warmup
steps. Note these differ from the checked-in OLMo-core kas_config.json,
which has lr 3e-4 / wd 0.01 and does not match the released models.
'max_duration' is 200 steps for a smoke test. A real 1-epoch run is ~109K

dataset.name: kas_vsl
_include_instance_metadata_comment: false on purpose. Chunk exclusion keys off batch['index'], never off the
per-chunk entity metadata, so training does not need to touch the 212GB
dataset-metadata tree. This is also what OLMo-core's own
